# Hacx 1.2 release archive

`hacx12.zip` is the official Hacx 1.2 release downloaded from the Hacx project’s Dr Nostromo download page on 2026-08-13.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Canonical source | <https://drnostromo.com/hacx/page.php?content=download> |
| Archive filename | `hacx12.zip` |
| SHA-256 | `70d25e8f4b48906759db32213927859a99b3b045d3291d468357b225d64cbf8b` |
| Contents used by build | `HACX.WAD`, `HACX.TXT` |
| Distribution condition | Royalty-free and strictly non-commercial; retain accompanying legal and credit material. |

The GitHub Pages workflow verifies this SHA-256 before extracting `HACX.WAD` into the deployed artifact. The deploy artifact also includes the release README plus `assets/licenses/HACX-LEGAL.txt` and `assets/licenses/HACX-CREDITS.txt`.

Do not replace this archive or change the distribution model without re-auditing the licence terms and updating `WAD_CATALOG_AUDIT.md`.
